def validate_solution(h):
    n = len(h)
    # Check integral
    integral = np.sum(h) * (2.0/n)
    if not np.allclose(integral, n/2, atol=4e-4):
        return False, "Integral mismatch"
    
    # Check bounds
    if any(h < -0.05) or any(h > 1.05):
        return False, "Boundary violation"
    
    # Avoid undefined states
    if np.sum(h) < 1 or np.sum(h) > n:
        return False, "Scale imbalance"
    
    return True, "Valid"
